_about: Machine form of the PLACE-CHARGE layer (moral-choices package, owner direction 2026-10-28): a place's EXISTENTIAL CHARGE — the system's own name, the owner's confirmed word (existential = what the charge IS). NUMINOUS / numinosity is the accepted register descriptor alongside it (numinous = how a charged place feels/presents; genius loci = a place's own spirit, classical production vocabulary). Both term families are PRODUCTION-LAYER ONLY: in-world and in UI, places are only ever said to be blessed, haunted, cursed, or lucky. The layer: every place may carry a charge — BASE charge (canon/owner-set, stored in the place's record, never rewritten by any system) and CURRENT charge (derived at read: base as drifted by long-arc story events and accumulated in-place deeds, capped, never flipped by player action). Charge is FELT, never itemised: no meter, no tally display, no UI label. Effects are fortune/perceptual only. The Dark Forest is the extreme case: the most numinous place in the world, the only ground where the deepest dread and the strongest luck coexist; its blessings arrive through the DREAD overlay's mediation (fates-dread-fragment.json ecologyMediation + resonance). The legendary-site archetype (peak charge bound to a one-time event, Pokemon-base lineage) ships with ZERO instances. All numbers are DRAFT system data; all assignments and tunings are owner slots (OWNER-SLOTS.md items 41-48). Landed homes cited, never re-founded: #7/#102 place data, #269 deed rows (place-carrying), the world-state producer's event record, #7/#52 encounter generation over effective tables, #84 roster binding, List 9 conservation law, List 32 #314 spectacle fence, DREAD-OVERLAY.md SS0a/SS5, WORLD-MEMORY.md spread machinery (one flagged seam). This fragment contains NO spawn data of any kind and assigns NO charge to any canon place as fact.

chargeRecord._about: A block on the place's own data (#7 area/place record, #102 derivation home). Base charge is stored canon data; current charge is NEVER stored - it is derived at read from base + drift inputs (currentChargeDerivation).

baseCharge.setBy: canon / the owner only - founded or changed by his word or a story event he rules; never rewritten by deeds, ecology, drift, or this layer
baseCharge.state: cursed | lucky | haunted | blessed | unmarked (closed vocabulary - chargeStates)
baseCharge.strengthBand: faint | settled | deep | peak (closed vocabulary - strengthBands)

chargeRecord.placeRef: the place's id in its own home - #7 area id / #102 place ref (area, town, or site)

chargeStates._about: Closed vocabulary, from the owner's words. State is what the place IS; strength is how hard it reads.
chargeStates.blessed: a presence that shelters - the place leans toward keeping what enters it
chargeStates.cursed: fortune leans away, and something in the lean feels meant - things go uncannily wrong
chargeStates.haunted: the past pressing in - what happened here has not finished happening
chargeStates.lucky: fortune leans in - things go uncannily right; no presence implied, just the lean
chargeStates.unmarked: the default - no lean the world answers to; most ground is unmarked

currentChargeDerivation._about: DERIVED at read, never stored as an edited field - the #270 discipline applied to places. Inputs: the stored base charge, story events, and accumulated in-place deed valence. Caps are absolute (see fences).
currentChargeDerivation.decay: deed-driven drift decays back toward the base read over drafted windows without reinforcement (places forgive slower than people); story-event changes do not decay - they are the new fact until another story fact answers them (windows DRAFT, OWNER-SLOTS item 43)
currentChargeDerivation.deedAccumulation: aggregate valence of #269 deed rows whose place is this place, over a drafted long window (seasons, not days): may move current strength at most one band per window toward the valence's pole (DRAFT, OWNER-SLOTS item 43)
currentChargeDerivation.flipRule: current charge NEVER reads a state different from base on deed accumulation alone; drift deepens or softens strength only. Founding a settled/deep charge on unmarked ground, or flipping any state, requires a story event the owner rules (OWNER-SLOTS item 44)
currentChargeDerivation.forestExemption: the Dark Forest takes NO deed drift: its charge is base-only (canon). Deeds done there feed the dread tallies and resonance (fates-dread-fragment.json), never a charge derivation - in the Forest the player does not move what the place is
inputs: story events (long-arc world/story events in the world-state producer's event record / story flags) - may deepen, soften, found, or (owner-ruled events only) flip; NONE instanced by this package
accumulated deeds in the place (#269 rows carry place) - strength drift only, capped
currentChargeDerivation.unmarkedGround: on an unmarked place, deed accumulation may raise at most a FAINT current lean, and faint leans decay; anything past faint is a story fact (owner slot)

draftSuggestions._about: Starting grid for the owner's pass - DRAFT SUGGESTIONS ONLY, each grounded in a cited canon fact. NONE of these is an assignment; an un-picked suggestion founds nothing. Assignment of any charge to any canon place is OWNER-SLOTS item 41.

suggestions.grounding: the owner's own direction (2026-10-28): the Forest can bless and reward, paranormally, and the luck there can exceed anywhere else; over the landed Forest record (dread cycle, the Unseen layer, what stopped moving)
suggestions.status: OWNER-DIRECTED - only its data encoding (the dual read's shape) is drafted; see forestExtremeCase
suggestions.suggestedRead: dual extreme: haunted pole at its deepest + blessing/luck pole at the game's ceiling, strength past the scale (peak region)

suggestions.grounding: canon record: 'dark, but not empty... bring Illuminate, and bring patience'; a place whose whole fact is that sound stays in it (door seated in the Dark Forest)
canon seat: the Bright garden - the world's own vocabulary already leans it toward shelter
Rule 12: 'Everything in the garden belongs to somebody... And everybody belongs to the Garden' - a belonging that holds people is the blessed register in the Garden's own words

effects._about: Two families only. Both stay at fortune/perception level (fairness floor below). Effect menus per state are drafted data (OWNER-SLOTS item 46); presence seats per place class are drafted (item 47).
fairnessFloor: charge never deals damage, imposes a condition, blocks the critical path, takes or grants an item, or fails a deadline
charge never writes the resolution of a battle or a capture attempt - it colours circumstances, never outcomes a landed system decides
fortune reads the EFFECTIVE table (after ecology overlay / Forest mediation); it never writes a table, adds a row, stocks a species, or changes a rate the tables own
misfortune is texture, never theft or harm: no item loss, no injury, no lost progress is ever a charge effect

examplesDraft.cursed: the path gone muddy, light failing early, the small wrong thing at the wrong moment, the meeting that starts wrong-footed
examplesDraft.lucky: a find at the grass edge (from the area's own find data), a door held open by wind, the storm breaking at shelter, the calm stocked slot stepping out first, a timely arrival the records scheduled

fortuneSide.rule: the texture of chance inside the place's existing machinery: encounter fortune (which already-stocked, already-derived slot the moment becomes - the near-miss, the hesitation, the one already turning away) and finds/coincidences in both directions

presenceSide.blessed: a presence that shelters: rest reads deeper (presentation only - landed rest systems own their numbers), weather spares the clearing, the wounded settle, dread thins at the edges; shelter FELT, never a mechanical safety flag
presenceSide.cursed: a wrongness that leans: attention that feels returned without a returner (drafted, per place class)
presenceSide.haunted: the past pressing in: sounds of things that happened there at the edge of hearing, shapes that resolve into nothing, ground where an old event's shape repeats faintly. PHENOMENA ONLY - never a creature, a ghost-individual, an encounter, or a capture target (the DREAD SS3 fence, applied to every charged place)
presenceSide.lucky: mostly NO presence read - luck is the lean without the watcher, part of what makes a merely-lucky place gentler than a blessed one

feltNeverItemised.rule: no charge meter, no tally display, no UI label, no Mochiioteca line reads out a place's state or band - the same discipline as the Forest's tallies (DREAD SS0a). The player learns a charge by being there, by what keeps happening, and by what locals say in ordinary words
feltNeverItemised.seeding: charge effects are seeded (place ref + world beat + derivation version) - reproducible and testable, never pure RNG: the same place in the same world state leans the same way

fences: depths spawn table EMPTY BY LAW (0 rows): charge never touches it - no charge effect manifests in the Dark Forest depths as population, encounter, or presence-with-a-target; the Forest's blessing works on the surface's reads like everything else the Forest does
canon spawn tables are never edited by this layer: charge effects ride the read-time overlay discipline - derived at read, traced to their inputs, never stored into a table

conservation law: charge never explains the Forest, the Secret, or what stopped moving; a haunted place's past pressing in is texture, never evidence - no phenomenon answers, hints at an answer to, or retires an arc question
phenomena are never creatures, encounters, species, spawn rows, or capture targets, in any charged place under any state; a presence is not a person and is never statted

vocabulary fence: 'existential charge', 'numinous', and 'genius loci' are production terms - they appear in no in-world text, UI string, sign, or Mochiioteca entry (LEAK RULE discipline); in-world, places are blessed, haunted, cursed, or lucky, and that is all anyone says

charge is not a morality aura on the player and not memory: it belongs to the place, predates the player's arrival, outlasts their leaving, and reads the same for every Ranger - what differs per Ranger is holders' memory (WORLD-MEMORY) and, in the Forest, resonance (DREAD SS5), never the charge
no new canon: this layer founds no place, person, event, legendary, item, or charge; it specifies machinery over places canon already holds and assigns none of them a state
charge reads and writes no ecology data: it consumes no pressure tallies and produces none (the Forest's tallies are DREAD SS0a's business)

forestExtremeCase._about: The owner's direction (2026-10-28): the Dark Forest is the most numinous place in the world - the only ground where the deepest dread AND the strongest luck in the game coexist. That it holds both, at the extremes, is his ruling; the dual read's exact data encoding is an owner slot (OWNER-SLOTS item 41).
forestExtremeCase.blessingShape: bent kindness bent TOWARD the player, hugely (DREAD SS0a bentKindness, direction reversed and at full strength): a loop-back returning you to exactly the clearing you needed; a rewiring putting the door in your path; the one changed detail being the detail that saves you; a migration completing somewhere impossible, with the thing you lost or spared standing in it
forestExtremeCase.chargeRead: base charge only (canon) - dual: haunted pole at its deepest + blessing/luck pole at the game's ceiling; strength in the peak region, past the ordinary scale. NO deed drift (currentChargeDerivation.forestExemption)
forestExtremeCase.indistinguishableAtFirst: a Forest blessing is at first indistinguishable from a haunting - scary, paranormal, mysterious by the owner's register; it announces itself with no marker and is never explained afterwards, by anyone, including the game
forestExtremeCase.luckCeiling: the game's highest (owner direction: the luck there can feel stronger than anywhere else in the game) - ceiling values DRAFT (OWNER-SLOTS item 46)
forestExtremeCase.mediation: blessings arrive ONLY through the dread overlay's mediation modes (fates-dread-fragment.json ecologyMediation.responseModes: delayed / partial / layer-split / warpedCompletion / bentKindness) - the Forest has no direct answers; cross-link DREAD-OVERLAY.md SS0a + SS5, not restated here
forestExtremeCase.neverSafe: blessings never make the Forest safe, never steady the depths, never empty the Unseen layer; resonance (DREAD SS5) still governs how close the Forest leans
forestExtremeCase.notALegendarySite: the Forest is named here ONLY as the charge-extreme the owner ruled. It is NOT classified as a legendary site (legendarySiteArchetype) unless the owner says so (OWNER-SLOTS item 48)

productionTerms.existentialCharge: the system's own name for the quality - the owner's confirmed word (existential = what the charge IS)
productionTerms.geniusLoci: classical production vocabulary: a place's own spirit
productionTerms.numinous: the accepted register descriptor (numinous / numinosity = how a charged place FEELS: presence, awe, dread in the ground itself)

instancing.assignments: NONE - no canon place is assigned a charge by this package; assignments are owner slots (item 41 for R1, item 42 for R2-5 wholesale)
instancing.definedFor: all regions - the machinery is region-blind
instancing.instancedFor: R1 only (standing boundary, List 4); R2-5 charge contents belong to the owner / design lane

legendarySiteArchetype._about: The peak-charge site class, inherited from the Pokemon base per the owner's Pokemon-base rule and recoded in this canon's terms: the sacred/special places of the base games (Spear Pillar / Bell Tower / Distortion World / Mt. Pyre class) are exactly this pattern - a place whose existential feeling is the design, bound to the singular thing that happened or waits there. The class ships EMPTY OF INSTANCES: no Mochiichao legendary site, legendary, singular item, or rite is invented, named, or implied by this package; all are canon/owner slots (OWNER-SLOTS item 48).
legendarySiteArchetype.afterTheEvent: the place's charge REMAINS - a legendary site does not empty out or go ordinary once its event is spent; what never repeats is the event
legendarySiteArchetype.chargeRead: base charge at MAXIMUM - the peak band, the region past deep where the Dark Forest's read also sits (the Forest is the charge-extreme; it is not thereby a legendary site - see forestExtremeCase.notALegendarySite)
legendarySiteArchetype.definition: a place whose existential charge sits at maximum AND is bound to a one-time event - a singular encounter, a singular item, a rite. The charge is the place's standing fact; the binding is what makes it a legendary site rather than merely a deeply charged one

eventBinding.oneTime: the event happens ONCE, ever: stored as a story/world-event fact in its landed home (the world-state producer's event record), not as a charge state - the charge record does not hold it, repeat it, or re-arm it
eventBinding.status: kinds DRAFT; no event of any kind is instanced by this package

legendarySiteArchetype.mechanicsRideCharge: site mechanics are charge mechanics - phenomena (presence-side, at maximum), fortune (fortune-side, at maximum lean), and mediation where the site's own system provides it (a Forest-class site mediates per DREAD SS0a) - the archetype founds no mechanics of its own
neverFarm: never a spawn row: the singular encounter is an EVENT, not an encounter-table entry - it is not on any table, at any rate, ever
never repeatable: no respawn, no re-roll, no second item, no grinding the site - after the event the place keeps its charge and its phenomena, and offers no second singular thing
charge effects at the site still obey the fairness floor (effects.fairnessFloor): maximum charge is still fortune/perception level - the EVENT is the singular content, not a charge payout
legendarySiteArchetype.pokemonBaseLineage: pattern inherited from the Pokemon base (sacred/special place + one-time legendary encounter/item), per the owner's Pokemon-base rule: Pokemon's legendaries are singular scripted events at charged places, never table spawns and never farmable - this archetype keeps that shape exactly

seamWithWorldMemory._about: FLAGGED - drafted, ONE joint only, owner slot (OWNER-SLOTS item 45). WORLD-MEMORY.md stays the people/faction system (acceptance profiles, memory records on holders); this layer is the PLACE system. The two records never duplicate: a place-as-holder holds memory records in WORLD-MEMORY's home; the place's charge lives in its place data here.
seamWithWorldMemory.rule: where a deed happened may colour how it is remembered: a choice-memory record's strength at birth, and its gossip spread, may read one band stronger (DRAFT) when the act happened in a charged place - a cruelty on blessed ground is remembered harder; a kindness in a cursed place travels further because it was unlikely there. The deed, its valence, and its #269 weight never change; only the memory's grip is coloured by the ground
seamWithWorldMemory.severable: if the owner severs the seam, the two systems never touch and nothing else in either layer notices

showLane: charge is casting language: lighting, sound, and phenomena staging by state (a blessed place held warm with one unaccountable source; a haunted place lit with one source too many; a lucky place where the timely arrival is a beat the records scheduled, not a writer's convenience). The Forest's seats are the landed keys 'Refusal' / 'No Key' (DREAD SS3). Numinous/existential vocabulary is never spoken on screen, no character theorises a place's charge, and List 32 #314's fence binds the lane: staged, never explained

strengthBands._about: Closed vocabulary (DRAFT band names). Applies to base charge (canon-set depth) and to the derived current read alike.
strengthBands.deep: the place's defining fact - the reason stories start there
strengthBands.faint: a lean - a tendency a visitor might name after a week
strengthBands.peak: maximum - the region past the top of the ordinary scale; the Dark Forest's read and the legendary-site class sit here (band name DRAFT, OWNER-SLOTS item 48)
strengthBands.settled: the place's known character - locals have a word for it

validation: Parses as JSON; vocabularies closed as named; every numeric value is DRAFT in-line or by its _about and listed in OWNER-SLOTS.md items 41-48. Landing cross-checks: assignment test (no canon place charge asserted as fact anywhere outside draftSuggestions, whose entries must carry their DRAFT/OWNER-DIRECTED status = required), flip test (the derivation as specified cannot output a state differing from base from deed inputs alone = required), depths test (any charge effect manifesting in the Dark Forest depths as population/encounter/targetable presence = build failure), spawn test (this fragment contains no spawn/species/encounter-table fields = required), legendary test (legendarySiteArchetype.instances must be empty and no legendary site/legendary/item may be named as Mochiichao canon anywhere in the package = required until the owner rules), leak test (no in-world or UI string anywhere in the package uses 'existential', 'numinous', or 'genius loci' for display - production data only).
